svg.title: E-commerce on Azure: request flows
svg.text: Five requests, five paths: what each shopper action touches
Everything enters through Front Door Premium and its WAF, then reaches AKS over Private Link. Only checkout writes to Azure SQL.
No SQL on the browse path.
Checkout calls each step in order and stops on the first failure. Every call carries the same idempotency key, so a retry can never charge twice.
• Peek-lock, complete only after the work is committed
• Idempotent: the same OrderPlaced twice changes nothing
• Max delivery count 10, then dead-letter and alert
• KEDA scales each worker on its own subscription depth
• Duplicate detection on the topic, MessageId = orderId
